Bibliography - Wikipedia cited as [6]; bare URLs, inconsistent formatting

technical_issues.issue: Statement 'A very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable' is incorrect/contradictory.
Drag sail paragraph is garbled and contradicts itself ('without thrusters... choose an uncontrolled descent... However, the ZYZZsat is without thrust capability').
Wikipedia used as a source, disallowed by task; references are bare URLs without titles/authors/dates.
Inclination-altitude plot presented without showing the underlying J2 hand calculation.

overall: A well-structured, mostly complete mission design for GBR reef monitoring with sound STK evidence and justified choices. Weakened by internal contradictions in the EOL section, unnumbered figures, missing software files, and improper referencing including Wikipedia.
